entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
I need to return a VeloBand Pulse HR monitor. Order number is VF-886-75309.
Okay, I'm pulling that up now. One moment... I see the order. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or just a preference?
It's not working. I don't have time for a long call, I just need to know if you'll take it back. Yes or no?
I understand you're busy. Can you tell me what you mean by 'not working'?
Look, it won't sync with my phone, the heart rate is completely inaccurate, I think the sensor is broken. It's defective and I want my money back.
I see. Typically for a defective item, we'd transfer you to our technical support team to troubleshoot, but let me first check the return eligibility based on the delivery date.
I don't want to troubleshoot. I want to return it. I've wasted enough time.

Of course. Let me just confirm the policy... Okay, I see the item was delivered 23 days ago. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days, so you are well within the window. I can process that return for you right now.

Absolutely. I've just initiated the return. You will receive an email with a prepaid shipping label within the next five minutes. Just pack the item in its original box and drop it off. Your refund will be processed once we receive it.
Fine. That's all I needed. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
